decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from pypa/packaging PR #1351 (issue #577), merged 2026-07-28, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. parse_tag validated empty components and component counts but not the interpreter itself, so a non-identifier interpreter like '2.7.6' passed through and the compressed-set dot-splitting turned it into three nonsense tags (2/7/6); parse_wheel_filename inherited the bug for wheels like playlyfe-0.1.1-2.7.6-none-any.whl. The fix (src/packaging/tags.py + src/packaging/utils.py, multi_file) raises InvalidTag for any interpreter component that is not a Python identifier, and adjusts the InvalidWheelFilename wrapping. Deliberately kept as an easy anchor for the difficulty band. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (b62954b6) to src/packaging plus the three LICENSE files, keeping the upstream src/ layout (test cmds use PYTHONPATH=src); packaging is dependency-free so the base sandbox image runs the hidden tests with pytest. Coverage: 4 fail_to_pass tests (7 cases with parametrize), each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch: the four non-identifier spellings from the upstream PR, a guard that a dotted interpreter is never split into multiple tags, and the wheel-filename level for both the real-world and the '+' spelling; 5 pass_to_pass guards pin identifier interpreters (including non-listed ones, enforcing a real identifier check over a hard-coded list), compressed-set expansion, empty-component and component-count rejections, and normal wheel-filename parsing. Assertions check exception TYPES and parsed values, never message text. Expected values generated from the gold patch behavior.
